title: Pink-haired Punk Girl
description: A confident young woman with bright pink hair in a high ponytail stands in a dynamic pose. She wears a pink and black punk outfit with shorts, harness straps, fingerless gloves, and heavy boots while holding a large purple spiked mace in one hand and a massive purple hammer with neon green markings on the other.
